items.title: Minutes - Board of Education - Special Meeting – October 2, 2023

enrichment.headline: Adopts a resolution approving 2023-24 Measure G1 grant proposals for named schools
enrichment.summary: The Board is adopting Resolution No. 2324-0157, which accepts the Measure G1 oversight commission's recommendation to approve 2023-2024 grant proposals for named schools. Measure G1 is the Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act. The item text does not list the schools or dollar amounts.

items.group: Measure G1 Commission – September 26, 2023 - Shivani Grover, Chairperson

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Measure G1 Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission - Measure G1 Funding Allocation - Named Schools

enrichment.headline: Pays KW Engineering up to $103,770 to check building systems at Roosevelt Middle School
enrichment.summary: KW Engineering will provide commissioning services, meaning checks that building systems and controls work and communicate properly, for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project. The amount includes up to $9,430 for additional services. Work is scheduled from October 12, 2023 to September 13, 2028.

vendor.name: Kilowatt Engineering, Inc., dba KW Engineering

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Engineering Services – KW Engineering – Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays KDI Group up to $54,324 for construction inspection on solar projects at four school sites
enrichment.summary: KDI Group, Inc. will serve as inspector of record and provide administrative support that meets Division of the State Architect (DSA) requirements for the Solar Initiative Project at Horace Mann, Madison Park, Oakland Academy of Knowledge and Esperanza. The amount includes up to $4,339 for additional services. Work is scheduled from October 12, 2023 to December 30, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Inspection of Record Services for Construction - KDI Group, Inc. - Solar Initiative Project -Various Sites: Horace Mann; Madison Park; Oakland Academy of Knowledge and Esperanza - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $1,220.74 to DecoTech's security camera contract at La Escuelita and Dewey Academy
enrichment.summary: This change order adds $1,220.74 so DecoTech Systems can replace patch cables and make networking changes to 19 cameras after a review of the existing cameras. It raises the contract limit from $190,500 to $191,720.74 for the security improvement project. All other terms stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – DecoTech Systems – La Escuellita Education Center and Dewey Academy Security Improvement - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Awards Building Block Interiors up to $177,457.99 for Pre-K furniture at Laurel Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: Building Block Interiors, the lowest responsible bidder, will provide, deliver and install Pre-K classroom furniture for the Laurel Child Development Center. The agreement lists a contingency allowance of $14,696.31. Work is scheduled from October 12, 2023 to January 1, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Purchase Order Contract Agreement – Building Block Interiors, Inc. – Laurel Child Development Center Furniture Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
